item.title: Paris court awards Kim Kardashian 1 euro after 2016 robbery
item.description: A Paris court has awarded Kim Kardashian 1 euro in compensation for an armed robbery she experienced in 2016

item.title: Judge rejects Trump tribute at Kennedy Center in sharp ruling
item.description: Sources say the Kennedy Center Board of Trustees voted to immediately close the performing arts center's main building.

item.title: What a $100,000 5-year CD could earn now
item.description: A $100,000 5-year CD can generate significant interest, though securing the best rates may not be easy.

item.title: Pentagon report: Iran war cost exceeds $33.4 billion
item.description: The Iran war has cost the U.S. military at least $33.4 billion, mostly for munitions, excluding hundreds of millions more spent by other agencies.
